messages:
pagerbot: INCIDENT 1823344555 - high error rate provisioning nodes in us-west-2 due to container image pull failures (Docker Hub / NV registry). paging infra-oncall and meera.kapoor :rotating_light:

meera.kapoor: I'm on it. saw spike in bootstrap failures around 03:14 UTC. kubelet logs show 401/429 from registry auth, also intermittent timeouts. customers hitting model endpoints saw elevated 5xx.

alex.tan: confirming - autoscaler trying to spin up nodes, node bootstrapping fails during `kubelet` image pull for runtime container. Example log: 
```
failed to pull image "nvcr.io/redwood/runtime:20.04-cuda11.8": error reading manifest: unauthorized: authentication required
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests\n```

benji.ng: interestingly we also see some `x-ratelimit` headers in the responses. looks like third-party token service is rejecting short-lived auth tokens used by our node init scripts.

infra-oncall: immediate mitigation: switching new node bootstrap to use our internal mirror (mirror.internal-registry.redwood) for runtime images. starting rollout to autoscaler config now (will only affect newly-provisioned nodes).

meera.kapoor: triggering quick prepull daemonset on current nodes for critical images where possible, to reduce churn during scale events. deploying prepull DS to us-west-2-prod now.

support-lead: customer impact: current metrics show ~22% of provisioning attempts in us-west-2 failed in the last 30m. Affected customers: a small subset of Dedicated clusters and some Hosted endpoints experiencing degraded capacity. Noting any active incidents for enterprise customers?

alex.tan: posting quick list of observed symptoms for triage:
- node bootstrap loop due to `docker`/`containerd` auth failures
- temporary 503/504s in model endpoints when autoscaler can't add capacity
- older nodes still serving are fine (cached images).

deploy-bot: deploy request accepted: autoscaler config patch to prefer mirror registry queued (PR #4572). will auto-apply after 60s if no failures.

meera.kapoor: also opening a support ticket with NVCR/DockerHub to get clarification on token throttling, forwarding 401/429 headers. adding logs and sample tokens.

benji.ng: short-term workaround idea: modify bootstrap to fallback to a shared, signed pull token stored in our KMS that has a longer TTL and is scoped to mirror pulls. risk: increases blast radius if leaked. want to do scoped read-only tokens and rotate nightly.

infra-oncall: rolling the autoscaler patch now to point to mirror.registry for `runtime` and `init` images. alerting: if node bootstrap fails more than 3 times in 10m, autoscaler will stop launching new nodes to avoid stampede.

pagerbot: NOTE: On-call handoff scheduled in 20 minutes. meera.kapoor will hand off to infra-oncall for next 8 hours. add a short summary to the handoff message.

meera.kapoor: Handoff summary (to infra-oncall):
- root cause: upstream registry auth/token service throttling and intermittent 401 from NV/DockerHub when exchanging ephemeral tokens during node bootstrap.
- impact: 20-25% bootstrap failure in us-west-2, transient capacity shortages for low-traffic Hosted endpoints and some Dedicated provisioning. No data plane compromise.
- mitigations applied: 1) autoscaler configured to use internal mirror for critical images, 2) prepull daemonset deployed to cache images on existing nodes, 3) backoff thresholds increased to avoid aggressive retries, 4) support ticket opened with registry provider.
- next steps: monitor successful bootstraps (metric: node.bootstrap.success rate), coordinate with registry vendor for rate-limit increase or token TTL changes, consider rolling AMI with images pre-baked as a short-term measure.

infra-oncall: ack. taking over. I'll validate PR and watch node bootstrap metrics. also enabling enhanced logging on node init to capture `www-authenticate` headers for downstream debugging.

support-lead: messaging: drafting a customer-facing note for impacted enterprise customers. priority customers will get a direct ping. public status update to go out if issue persists >90m.

alex.tan: small tweak: add retry jitter in bootstrap script and exponential backoff to reduce concurrent token exchange storms. pushing patch to bootstrap repo now.

benji.ng: also adding a fallback path in the bootstrap to `curl` and retry from mirror.internal-registry if primary fails with 401/429. config snippet:
```
if pull_fails && http_status in (401,429):\n  sleep $((RANDOM % 10 + backoff))\n  try pull from mirror.internal-registry.redwood\n```

meera.kapoor: note: this will allow nodes in an autoscaling burst to fall back to the mirror quickly and reduce repeated token exchanges.

infra-oncall: infra dashboard shows node.bootstrap.success jumped from 70% -> 94% after mirror switch and prepull. endpoint 5xx rate decreased accordingly. continuing to monitor.

pagerbot: INVESTIGATION: Root cause suspected to be ephemeral token exchange rate-limits on the registry auth proxy. vendor ticket ID: NVCR-8732. vendor response: "we're seeing auth backend overload, temporary throttling for short-lived tokens in this region."

support-lead: prepare PSR notes: who was impacted, timeframe, mitigations, and action items for postmortem. setting up a quick bridge for stakeholders in 30m.

meera.kapoor: request to security: are we okay to use longer-lived mirror-signed tokens? tagging @security in case they want to review risk.

benji.ng: security: we limited the mirror token scope to `pull-only` and restricted IP CIDR to infra egress ranges. rotating nightly via Key Manager. posted config to infra-secrets.

infra-oncall: follow-up actions I'm keeping on my board:
- coordinate with vendor to remove throttling or adjust quotas (owner: infra-oncall)
- evaluate baking runtime images into AMIs for short-term stability (owner: alex.tan)
- add a health-check to detect registry auth 401/429 and automatically switch to mirror (owner: benji.ng)
- postmortem in incidents channel with TTL and customer impact (owner: meera.kapoor)

deploy-bot: autoscaler config patch applied: mirror registry prioritized.

pagerbot: RESOLVED: observed sustained bootstrap success >95% for 45min and endpoint 5xx dropped to baseline. status: mitigated. keeping ticket open until vendor confirms.

meera.kapoor: handoff: infra-oncall retains incident ownership. I'll prepare a postmortem draft with timeline, root cause analysis, and remediation plan. tagging this for priority: infra/registry-hardening.

infra-oncall: taking notes for postmortem. any remaining action items?

support-lead: will follow up with targeted customer notifications and update SSO/Support runbook to include mirror fallback steps.

benji.ng: i'll open a small PR to add the mirror fallback to bootstrap and add unit tests for the logic.

meera.kapoor: thanks team. closing active paging now. if vendor confirms permanent quota change we'll roll back the mirror preference and rely on upstream again.

pagerbot: INCIDENT CLOSED at 1823345120. Participants: meera.kapoor, infra-oncall, alex.tan, benji.ng, support-lead.
